name: VOIDWRIGHT
description: Build ships and stations block by block in an open universe: eight home worlds, then generated planet groups that load as you travel, on a map that grows as you discover them. Land anywhere, dig real tunnels through planets and asteroids, fly through forests. 86 large and small grid blocks, real thrust and mass, a jetpack, jump drives, waypoints. Creative mode, or survival: mine with drills and rock crushers, refine, assemble, weld every block up from a frame, and keep your oxygen and hydrogen topped up.
